title: Effects of selenium-enriched prebiotic on the growth performance, innate immune response, oxidative enzyme activity and microbiome of rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss)

study_system.detail: single recirculating aquaculture system with 15 polyethylene tanks

study_objective: To evaluate the effect of selenoneine-enriched Schizosaccharomyces pombe prebiotic supplementation on rainbow trout production and health, including growth, immune response, oxidative status and microbiome.

facility_production_system.detail: 15 tanks, 170 L each; bead and sand filters, nitrification bioreactor, UV disinfection and chiller

temporal_scope: 8-week feeding trial; sampling at weeks 4 and 8

focal_factor.detail: selenoneine-enriched, whole-cell inactivated S. pombe at 0, 5 or 10 g kg-1 feed

comparison.detail: control diet versus 0.5% and 1.0% selenium-enriched S. pombe diets

study_outcome.detail: weight gain, feed conversion ratio, condition factor, hepatosomatic and viscerosomatic indices, survival
superoxide dismutase and glutathione peroxidase activity

title: Evaluation of the biosecurity and network of the Irish salmonid farming industry: implications for disease prevention and control

study_system.detail: Irish freshwater, seawater and freshwater-lake salmonid farms

study_objective: To characterize biosecurity of Irish salmonid farms, develop a score for benchmarking biosecurity, and test whether biosecurity score and farm network indegree predict pathogen richness.

life_stage.detail: production stages represented by freshwater and seawater farms

facility_production_system.detail: broodstock, freshwater and seawater production settings; freshwater lake farm

temporal_scope: survey of active Irish salmonid farms during the study period; pathogen richness assessed over one year

focal_factor.detail: farm network indegree / number of fish suppliers

comparison.detail: freshwater salmon, seawater salmon and freshwater trout farms
farm biosecurity score and indegree categories in pathogen-richness models

study_outcome.detail: number of different diseases affecting a farm during a year

title: A Serving of Farmed Salmon: How the Risks Outweigh the Benefits for Norwegians

study_system.detail: Norwegian consumers / dietary exposure to farmed salmon

study_objective: To quantitatively compare contaminant and marine omega-3 concentrations in Norwegian farmed salmon servings with established tolerable or recommended intake levels.
temporal_scope: uses reported contaminant data from 2001–2005 and reference intake values

focal_factor.detail: fish oil versus vegetable oil in salmon feed as discussed in relation to contaminant and fatty-acid concentrations

comparison.detail: contaminant and omega-3 intake from a 130 g/200 g farmed salmon serving versus established tolerable/recommended intakes

study_outcome.detail: dioxins, dioxin-like PCBs, indicator PCBs and PBDEs

new_code_candidate_detail: study_system may require a controlled food_product / dietary_exposure category if this type of paper recurs

title: Threshold-based disease treatment approach modulates economic, conservation and evolutionary trade-offs in sea louse-salmon aquaculture system.

farmed_species.detail: salmon hosts in the domestic production environment

study_system.detail: domestic salmon aquaculture, coastal/link environment and wild salmon environment

geography.detail: model system parameterized for salmon aquaculture; system-specific values draw on published sources

study_objective: To use a dynamical model with discrete threshold-based treatment to explore evolutionary, conservation and economic outcomes in the sea louse-salmon system.

life_stage.detail: out-migrating juvenile, adult, spawning and wild salmon populations represented in the model

facility_production_system.detail: domestic production environment; no specific facility type specified

temporal_scope: continuous-time dynamics with discrete treatment pulses; outcomes averaged over final simulation periods

comparison.detail: varying treatment thresholds and treatment efficacy
economic, conservation and evolutionary outcome dimensions

study_outcome.detail: economic losses from disease burden and treatment cost
